messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MSPO deregisters at the GO. The GO verifies the deregistration. The GO rejects the deregistration of the MSPO or the GO preliminarily confirms the deregistration of the MSPO. The GO assigns himself as MSP. The GO informs the MSPO about the end of the assignment and the beginning of the assignment of the GO. The GO informs the MPO about the assignment of the GO. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the GO.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPO_Deregistration" name="MSPO Deregistration Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="MSPO deregisters at the GO">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Verify" name="GO verifies the deregistration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Decision on Deregistration" gatewayDirection="Unspecified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Deregistration Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejects the deregistration">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assign_MSP" name="GO assigns himself as MSP">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_Assign_MSP" name="Preliminarily confirms the deregistration">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Confirmed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inform_MSPO" name="GO informs MSPO about end of assignment and beginning of GO assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inform_MPO" name="GO informs MPO about assignment of GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inform_SP" name="GO informs SP about assignment of GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Process Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Verify" targetRef="Gateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Assign_MSP" targetRef="Task_Inform_MSPO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Inform_MSPO" targetRef="Task_Inform_MPO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Inform_MPO" targetRef="Task_Inform_SP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Inform_SP" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
